verdict.rationale: Gumloop is an agent platform where you give an agent a goal in plain language and it decides which tools to call and when to ask for input (gumloop-docs-34). You can also reconfigure an agent conversationally, for example "Update your instructions…" or "Turn this into a skill" (gumloop-docs-2), and reach agents through chat in Slack, Teams or email (gumloop-docs-39, gumloop-docs-40, gumloop-docs-41). Missing for 10: evidence that platform-level setup (creating agents, adding connectors, configuring triggers) can be done through natural language rather than the UI, since connectors are documented as added via the Connectors section; also no independent or hands-on corroboration.
